trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Removed books are kept for 30 days, then deleted for good. Removing a book again replaces older copies that have no notes or rating. Only the newest 1,000 are kept.
trash.emptyBody: Books you remove from your library appear here for 30 days. You can restore them until then.

trash.restoreNotFound: This book is no longer in the trash.
trash.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore this book. Try again.
